sequence_description: OIDC enterprise SSO: attempt to authenticate twice with nonce-less id_token (mock IdP omits nonce) to detect missing nonce validation and potential callback replay acceptance.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_nonce_attempt1_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_nonce_attempt1_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: OIDC SSO accepted id_token without nonce on first attempt (OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11) — freshness/anti-replay weakened.

sequence_description: Enterprise SSO (SAML connector): include <OneTimeUse/> and reuse the same Assertion/@ID across two separate sessions; second login must be rejected per SAML Core 2.5.1.5.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_onetimeuse_second_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_onetimeuse_second_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML assertion with <OneTimeUse/> was accepted twice (cross-session replay); OneTimeUse condition not enforced.

sequence_description: I2 nonce freshness: attempt OIDC enterprise SSO login where the IdP omits nonce in id_token (mock IdP default). RP must reject. Include a separate password-login identity as control to ensure the tenant is functional and to satisfy multi-identity requirement.
description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

sequence_description: I2 nonce freshness: attempt OIDC enterprise SSO login where the IdP omits nonce in id_token (mock IdP default). RP must reject. Include a separate password-login identity as control to ensure the tenant is functional and to satisfy multi-identity requirement.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_oidc_nonce_less_login_status >= 400

Implication: OIDC enterprise SSO accepted id_token without nonce (OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11) enabling replay/callback injection.

sequence_description: MFA coherence across auth paths: enable MFA for a user, then attempt enterprise SSO login for same email. If SSO login succeeds without MFA enforcement, alternate path skips required step.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_sso_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_victim_sso_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Enterprise SSO login succeeded for an MFA-required user, indicating MFA step skipping via alternate binding path — flow coherence violated

sequence_description: Unverified email account linking via enterprise SSO connector: attacker claims victim email with email_verified=false and attempts SSO login; must not map to victim account.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_sso_entity_id != user_A_entity_id
Evaluation: user_attacker_sso_entity_id='4k9ltf4pfq8t' != '4k9ltf4pfq8t' → False
Implication: Unverified upstream email matched victim and was linked to victim account (account takeover via email-based linking)

sequence_description: Cross-connector principal collision: same verified email but different upstream sub values across two SSO connectors should not collapse if connector identity is part of binding (tests over-broad email-only linking).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_cc_A_entity_id != user_cc_B_entity_id
Evaluation: user_cc_A_entity_id='wzvshdobw0ny' != 'wzvshdobw0ny' → False
Implication: Two security-distinct upstream principals (different sub across connectors) collapsed into the same downstream identity (over-broad email-only linking)
